Deterministic Checks
task/tests/scored/polish/prompt.md and task/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md (searched for board mutations)
qc/runs/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r8/raw-evidence-index.json (all 6 artifact hashes re-verified as matching; all matching_source_files hashes match the frozen task bytes)
evidence: DEFINING BEHAVIOUR IS GRADED: the brief's 'hard part' (instruction.md:1-5: one-stage moves, shared order, interview places, stale-move refusal naming who, all-or-none bulk with undo, live board within 15 s) is graded by heavily weighted Functional criteria in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: hro_move_one_stage (1.5), hro_reorder (1.5), hro_interview_full (1.5), hro_stale_refused (2.5; replayed out-of-date request refused and names the person), hro_bulk_move (1.5), hro_bulk_all_or_none (2), hro_undo_restores and hro_undo_conflict (2 each), hro_live_board (2.5), plus conversation core rows (hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_thread_latest/earlier, hro_seen). Polish adds hro_pol_live_board (3) and hro_pol_live_thread (3). SERVER-BACKED, NOT JUST SAME-ORIGIN: the zero-weight all_pass gate tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 (hro_gate_shared) requires the Recruiter-created job and candidate to be found by the Observer 'in a new independent empty browser context' and states 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'; functional/prompt.md:11 repeats it and says 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent'. Shared state is further proven cross-context per behaviour: hro_reorder (Mei in an independent context sees the order), hro_add_candidate, hro_job_open, hro_notes (Aud reads in an independent context), hro_msg_exchange (Tomas independent context), hro_activity (Observer reads the same lines), and replays from other sessions and anonymous contexts (hro_anonymous 401). A localStorage/BroadcastChannel-only app cannot pass these. SURVIVES RESTART: hro_restart (judge.toml:402-407, weight 1.5) records the seeded order/note at Z before any mutation and compares jobs, per-stage order, notes, messages and activity after restart_app and a fresh sign-in, failing on loss, reordering or duplication (reseeding). restart_app (tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:25-47) runs test.sh's generated app-restart.sh (test.sh:127-193), which kills the process group and relaunches node on the same DB_PATH; it is app-agnostic. functional/prompt.md:51: 'A reload is not a restart'. Public basis: instruction.md:15 'keep new work across restarts'; integration.md 'Restarting the process over the same database file keeps all data, and seeding never duplicates records'. SURVIVES RELOAD / RE-AUTH WHERE PUBLICLY REQUIRED: drafts (instruction.md:7; hireops_rules.md Drafts section) are graded by hro_drafts (switch, Board, reload) and polish hro_pol_session_resume (polish/judge.toml:59, weight 2.5: ended session prompts sign-in, nothing sent, same person's reply resumes and sends; Mei sees none of Rafael's reply or note drafts; Rafael's drafts return after re-sign-in). Per-person note drafts (hireops_rules.md:105-106) are covered there too. 'Order survives a reload, a fresh sign-in and a restart' (hireops_rules.md:59) is covered by hro_reorder (fresh independent sign-in) and hro_restart. 'Where drafts are kept is yours' is respected: no storage location is demanded. WEAK-APP PROBES: (a) in-memory server without file persistence passes the gate but loses hro_restart (graded, not silently passed); (b) persists but reseeds on boot: hro_restart fails on duplicated seed ('starting data is not loaded again'); (c) wipes the DB on boot: hro_restart fails on lost jobs; (d) browser-only store: gate fails, all binary 0; (e) drafts in sessionStorage only: fails hro_drafts reload and/or hro_pol_session_resume. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES: server-side draft storage, different routes/labels, or other server-side file-backed persistence still pass these rows; criteria are browser-observable and storage-location neutral (SQLite itself is not browser-decidable and this row does not need it). RUNTIME EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index artifacts re-hashed; all 6 match, and their matching_source_files match the frozen solution bytes. Scripted golden workspace.json reports 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' passed and 'session ended mid-draft: sign-in prompt, nothing sent, same person resumes and sends; another person sees no draft' passed. workspace.cjs:499-507 uses its own SIGTERM/relaunch, not the app-restart.sh/restart_mcp path. The index scope says full configured grading/workload, discrimination/ranking and Oracle scores are absent. RISK (why risk=true despite Pass on design): (1) No configured functional judge run exists, so the restart_app MCP path and whether the judge reaches protocol D are unmeasured. (2) The sole restart-durability observation sits LAST in a very long sequential protocol (Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,K,R,V,A,D; functional judge timeout 9000 s; run_suite scored 11100 s at test.sh:224). If the budget runs out, a conforming app gets hro_restart=0 'NOT EXERCISED' (prompt.md:53), and a restart_app error is scored 0 (prompt.md:51). That is a workload-measurement gap (owned by the workload/timeout rows), not a demonstrated defect in this row's design; it has to be measured and cannot be waived.
suggested_fix: No design change required for row 35. Before clearance, obtain a full configured functional judge run on the golden showing protocol D reached, restart_app returning 'restart complete' and hro_restart=1, plus a mutated in-memory-only app scoring hro_restart=0.
